_comment: Edit this file to set your searches. Each search needs either a pasted Autotrader motorhome-search URL or a criteria block. See README.md for every supported key.

details._comment: Each new advert's page is fetched once to read its features and description. maxFetchesPerRun caps how many per run; delayMs is the pause between requests; adverts whose page says fewer berths than excludeIfBerthBelow are treated as unconverted vans and hidden.

deals._comment: An advert is 'worth a look' if it has at least minWantedSpecs of wantedSpecs, or its price net of kit is underpricedPercent below similar live adverts (adjusted for age and mileage when there are enough), or the seller looks motivated (listed staleDays+ with a price drop, or two drops). Any red flag removes it from the list.
